messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — we're planning an incompatible change to the partner SDK adapter envelope + auth header. Need to schedule a marketplace adapter freeze for staging the week of May 5. Who can own partner comms and migration materials?

Devin Patel: I can draft the partner note. Is the change for both HTTP SDKs and websocket connectors?

Sasha Ilyin: Both. TL;DR: rename header `X-Redwood-Client` -> `X-RW-Client-Info` and remove top-level `meta.trace` field from response envelope. Old clients will receive 400 if they keep the legacy envelope.

Oliver Grant: can you paste a minimal example so partners can see diffs?

Sasha Ilyin: ```
# old
curl -H "X-Redwood-Client: {\"id\":\"abc\"}" https://adapter.partner.example/api/generate
# new
curl -H "X-RW-Client-Info: {\"id\":\"abc\",\"env\":\"prod\"}" https://adapter.partner.example/api/generate
```

Maria Chen: Exactly. We'll also ship a runtime flag `accept-legacy-envelope=false` in the next release; default will flip to false during the rollout.

Lee Park: For staging we'll need marketplace adapter images tagged `redwood/adapter:v2026-05-staged` plus a `:rollback` tag. Eng-platform can build those.

partner-bot: Calendar booking created: marketplace-staging-reservation May 5 02:00 UTC — calendar.redwood/marketplace-staging/3045678910 :white_check_mark:

Devin Patel: Plan: partner draft by Apr 18, private partner previews Apr 20–24, public blog Apr 25, staging freeze May 5, production flip May 12. Does that timeline work?

Maria Chen: Partners will need a 2-week pin window before we flip. Also ask SI integrators to run their end-to-end tests against staging. Can we provide a small validation script they can run?

Oliver Grant: Yep — I'll add `validate_adapter.sh` to the doc that checks header presence, envelope shape, and a sample generate call. Keeps onboarding friction low.

Sasha Ilyin: We'll also expose a temporary canary endpoint on staging that accepts legacy header for a 24h overlap so partners can sanity-check without changing prod traffic.

Lee Park: Confirmed — infra will create a canary route + one-off capacity pool for the window.

Devin Patel: I'll draft the migration guide + deprecation timeline and loop in legal for partner wording and PMM for the joint announcement cadence.

Maria Chen: :thumbsup: I'll compile an owner list and share the partner ping thread after Devin posts the first draft. Thanks everyone — keeping this tight will save a lot of last-minute rollbacks.
